title: Synthesis and evaluation of resveratrol–cerium modified hydroxyapatite for enhanced bone repair scaffolds
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,10565-10581
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA10060G, Paper

Dezhou Wang, Min Guo, Yuqi Gao, Shengrui Gao, Wanzhong Yin, Wenzhi Song
PCL scaffolds incorporated with Res–Ce MPN-modified HA nanoparticles were prepared. They show synergistic antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and osteogenic activities, effectively promoting bone defect repair with excellent biosafety.
